description: Single package with tsconfig path aliases and file-vs-directory-index shadowing (the probe-tracking cases).

scenarios.name: shadowed-index-change
scenarios.description: '../utils' resolves to src/utils.ts, so src/utils/index.ts is dead code from legacy.ts's point of view.

scenarios.name: delete-shadowing-file
scenarios.description: Deleting src/utils.ts re-points '../utils' at src/utils/index.ts. legacy.ts never changed, but its resolution did.

scenarios.name: add-shadowing-file
scenarios.description: Adding src/config.ts shadows src/config/index.ts for '../config'. Only a negative-probe-aware cache catches this.

scenarios.name: tsconfig-change
scenarios.description: tsconfig changes are a global trigger: compilation of everything in scope may differ.
